biological.citation: Wang et al. 2020 - De novo CACNA1D Ca(2+) channelopathies: clinical phenotypes and molecular mechanism (PMID: 32583268)
biological.summary: CACNA1D encodes the pore-forming α1 subunit of Cav1.3 L-type Ca2+ channels. Somatic de novo missense variants in aldosterone-producing adenomas and germline variants in neurodevelopmental disorders cause gating changes that enhance Ca2+ influx (gain of function). The review summarizes 12 individuals with 9 high-risk pathogenic variants and discusses L-type channel blockers as a possible therapy.

biological.citation: Ca(v)1.3 (CACNA1D) L-type Ca(2+) channel dysfunction in CNS disorders (PMID: 26842699)
biological.summary: Cav1.3 is needed for cardiac pacemaking, hearing and hormone secretion, and is expressed postsynaptically in neurons, where it shapes firing and plasticity. Loss of function in knockout mice and humans does not cause neuropsychiatric disease. Gain-of-function de novo missense mutations are linked to ASD, seizures and primary aldosteronism, and acute pharmacological activation of Cav1.3 causes depressive-like behaviour in mice.

biological.citation: Biophysical classification of a CACNA1D de novo mutation as a high-risk mutation for a severe neurodevelopmental disorder (PMID: 31921405)
biological.summary: In tsA-201 cells, patch-clamp showed that S652L shifted activation and inactivation by about 13-17 mV to more negative voltages, increased window currents, slowed tail currents and increased Ca2+ levels, all gain-of-function changes. It also increased sensitivity to isradipine 3-4-fold. The S652W variant found in healthy individuals shifted gating to more positive voltages, consistent with loss of function.
biological.sample_size: Two affected twins (S652L); heterologous expression in tsA-201 cells

biological.citation: CaV1.3 enhanced store operated calcium promotes resistance to androgen deprivation in prostate cancer (PMID: 35193095)
biological.summary: CACNA1D expression and a shortened 170 kDa CaV1.3 isoform increased after androgen deprivation (bicalutamide) in patients, LNCaP xenografts and cell lines. This isoform did not mediate depolarisation-induced Ca2+ influx. Instead it raised basal cytosolic Ca2+ and store-operated calcium entry (SOCE), which promoted proliferation and survival of castration-resistant cells.

biological.citation: Data pertaining to aberrant intracellular calcium handling during androgen deprivation therapy in prostate cancer (PMID: 35496494)
biological.summary: Among the calcium channels tested, only CACNA1D mRNA rose during androgen deprivation in the LNCaP, LNCaP-ADT, LNCaP-ABL and PC3 models. CACNA1D siRNA knockdown reduced SOCE and proliferation in PC3 cells without changing ORAI1 or STIM1 expression. Nifedipine had no effect on store release, SOCE or proliferation.

biological.citation: Retrocochlear function of the peripheral deafness gene Cacna1d (PMID: 22678062)
biological.summary: Conditional deletion of Cacna1d (Cav1.3) in the auditory brainstem with Egr2::Cre left the inner ear intact. The superior olivary complex lost 43-47% of its volume and 46-56% of its cells. Auditory brainstem responses were altered and Kv1.2 expression was reduced, showing a perinatal role for Cav1.3 in central auditory development.

biological.citation: The SWI/SNF chromatin-remodeling subunit DPF2 regulates macrophage inflammation in intestinal injury via the CACNA1D-mediated MAPK pathway (PMID: 41223220)
biological.summary: Dpf2 loss in macrophages reduced H3K27ac and H3K4me1 at the Cacna1d enhancer, lowering Cacna1d mRNA and intracellular calcium. This attenuated MAPK signaling and drove anti-inflammatory macrophage polarization. DPF2, CACNA1D and intestinal inflammation correlated positively in IBD single-cell data, organoids and clinical samples.

biological.citation: Dominant role of CACNA1D exon mutations for blood pressure regulation (PMID: 35142739)
biological.summary: CRISPR-Cas9 knock-in Sprague-Dawley rats carrying CACNA1D p.D307G developed elevated systolic blood pressure, higher circulating ET-1, and vascular, cardiac and renal remodeling. VSMCs showed increased Cav1.3 protein and calcineurin activity, and vascular ring tension was increased. Isradipine and the ET-1 inhibitor BQ-123 lowered blood pressure in double-mutant rats.

biological.citation: Cellular and Genetic Causes of Idiopathic Hyperaldosteronism (PMID: 30354720)
biological.summary: Sequencing of 99 aldosterone-producing cell clusters (APCCs) from 15 idiopathic hyperaldosteronism adrenals found somatic CACNA1D mutations in 57 (58%), compared with KCNJ5 in only 1 (1%). CACNA1D is therefore the dominant aldosterone-driver gene in these lesions and a potential therapeutic target.

biological.citation: ASHG 2015 - Epigenomic profiling of prostate cancer identifies differentially methylated genes in TMPRSS2:ERG fusion positive versus negative tumors
biological.summary: CACNA1D is a known ERG target. It showed gene-body hypomethylation and mRNA overexpression in TMPRSS2:ERG fusion-positive prostate cancer, with confirmatory evidence in TCGA.
